notes.title: New Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34524466/404442ee5597b310f295378a6a942766d483a653.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!
I keep working hard on Crumbling World, to improve the player's experience and fixing bugs.

Here is the Changelog for Patch 1.1.2:

[list]
[*] Fixed major bug related to Wizard and Brute Classes. The game was stuck in the transition scene when changing levels. This has been fixed and now the game works properly. 
[*] Changed Quality Graphics Settings, now by default the game is set to Best Quality.
[*] Enhanced Graphics and weather effects.
[*] Improved and resized maps. Now maps are 10-15% bigger depending on the Difficulty Level.
[*] Leveling Up has been balanced, it's more fair and you need more XP to level up.
[/list]

Thanks so much for your support.

notes.title: CrumblingWorld Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34524466/3bf558f2e1397cfcc179529b3926514b2494ba73.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! This is a small patch that fixes a bug in the Unique Enemies spawner.
The Unique Enemy was spawned in a different location, so it was very difficult for the player to find it and keep progressing. Now the Unique Enemy is spawned in a closer location to the player so it can be easily found and defeated.

Thanks so much for keep reporting bugs and issues. I appreciate it very much!

notes.title: Crumbling World: New Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34524466/13041ea98e4766978cd6a1560dcb20872015499c.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! The new patch 1.0.7 for #CrumblingWorld is out now.

The major fixes are:
[list]
[*] Improved Spawner for Enemies and Objects avoid overlapping
[*] Increased Players speed 
[*] Increased Enemies's difficulty
[*] Improved Enemies's AI
[*] Fix Wolves (Creature's Special Attack) not spawning in Underworld
[*] Smoothed transitions to enchain attacks and reverted physics settings improve "jittering" animations
[*] Fixed Boat behaviors
[*] Changed time step and rigid body extrapolation
[*] Animal Enemy improved behavior
[*] Fixed issues with projectiles for Magic and Archer Enemies
[*] Fixed issue with Player Blocking and Stamina Use
[/list]

If you still experience any issues, please let me know in the comments below.

Thanks so much for your support!
